visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a vertical view of a modern, multi-story grey apartment building in Singapore, showing balconies and large windows under a bright, overcast sky. (2) Two people approach a metal security gate where two men, Andee and Hugo, stand smiling and waving from the other side. One person is wearing a black hat and a green messenger bag. (3) Inside a bright, modern apartment, the camera shows a living room with a light beige sofa, a circular glass side table with a metal frame, and large glass doors leading to a balcony. (4) Transition to a minimalist kitchen with sleek grey cabinetry, an under-cabinet light strip, a stainless steel sink, and a black induction cooktop. (5) Close-up shots of two framed minimalist map posters on a wall, one of Taipei and one of Singapore. (6) Two men are interviewed in the apartment; one wears a black sleeveless top showing arm tattoos, and the other wears a black t-shirt. They use animated facial expressions and hand gestures while speaking. (7) Close-ups of their hands show they are wearing silver wedding rings.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台 HahaTai. [Slogan]: 新加坡. [Subtitle]: 傑尼和蓋瑞來到了一間新的Condo. (2) [Subtitle]: 嗨. [Variety]: 好像來探監喔. (3) [Subtitle]: 這兩位就是住在Condo的Andee和Hugo. (4) [Slogan]: 租屋資訊 Hugo Tampines 1700萬台幣/10坪左右. (5) [Subtitle]: 問一下這是多少平方米. (6) [Subtitle]: 折和坪數的話大概就是10坪左右 一房一廳. (7) [Subtitle]: 大概台幣1700多萬. (8) [Subtitle]: 那這樣的話你們一個月大概要繳多少錢呢 房貸什麼的. (9) [Subtitle]: 5萬塊、6萬塊台幣. (10) [Subtitle]: 如果是這樣的話你們為什麼不買HDB. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為這邊不行. (12) [Subtitle]: 新加坡是如果你要買HDB的話你要是結婚的或是35歲以上才可以買. (13) [Variety]: 或是一定要是異性戀. (14) [Subtitle]: 我們是夫夫已結婚. (15) [Subtitle]: 你們在哪裡結的啊 在台灣 回去台灣結. (16) [Subtitle]: 但是新加坡這邊的話我們是單身. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以你那個護照或者是你那個身分證他是不能...不認的. (18) [Subtitle]: 但他會寫說是已婚 反正就就沒有配偶. (19) [Subtitle]: 當初買這間房子是就是誰的主控權比較大. (20) [Variety]: (都嘴). (21) [Subtitle]: 我是從小住國宅長大 就我沒有想過自己會住condo. (22) [Subtitle]: 所以你那時候他說要買 有想說 感覺就是會不會. (23) [Variety]: 有必要嗎?. (24) [Subtitle]: 現在我已經35了 我現在就跟他說 不然我們搬去HDB 然後他就說 不要. (25) [Subtitle]: 要住就住好的. (26) [Slogan]: 由奢入儉難 - Hugo. (27) [Subtitle]: 新加坡有一個法律 377A 就以前是兩個男生如果有性行為就是非法. (28) [Subtitle]: 但是那個法律在三、四年前被移除了. (29) [Subtitle]: 兩個男生有性行為非法的話 怎樣會被抓 對啊 誰會抓你. (30) [Subtitle]: 就是他們說是非法但是他們沒有執行過這個法律. (31) [Variety]: 有嚇阻 但不多. (32) [Subtitle]: 所以你們未來有打算要再換房子嗎. (33) [Variety]: 國宅 國宅. (34) [Subtitle]: 很想搬回去國宅 回台灣 回台灣. (35) [Variety]: 完了 又要吵架了.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts with the exterior of a high-end condo in Singapore with a pool. Most of the video takes place inside a modern, clean apartment with white walls, grey minimalist kitchen units, and large windows.

A male voice introduces the scene with high enthusiasm and energy. (2) A metallic rattling sound of a gate is heard, followed by a burst of group laughter from multiple male voices. The BGM continues steadily. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of a text graphic. The main speakers discuss house prices in a casual, conversational tone with moderate speech rate. (4) A comic 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during a scene transition. Laughter punctuates the conversation as they discuss legal restrictions in Singapore. (5) The audio remains dense with speech, music, and occasional cartoon-style impact sounds that highlight comedic moments. The BGM swells slightly during transitions but remains subordinate to the dialogue.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the living situation and personal story of a same-sex couple living in a Singaporean condo, while highlighting the legal and financial challenges they face regarding housing and marriage recognition in Singapore.
